semiconductor_relevance: High — JTEC Corporation specializes in advanced surface processing technologies that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: JTEC Corporation offers innovative surface shaping methods for semiconductor materials, focusing on precision polishing and etching technologies. Their capabilities include Plasma CVM, CARE, PAP, and ECMP, which enhance the performance and reliability of semiconductor wafers.
capabilities: Plasma CVM for dry etching with high-density radicals
CARE for atomic-level surface finishing using pure water and metal catalysts
PAP for polishing hard materials like diamond with reduced defects
ECMP for electrochemical polishing of SiC wafers
